description: Defines the RingBufferParcelable class for managing shared memory buffers in Android's AAudio system, including setup, accessors, and update methods.

classes.name: RingBufferParcelable
classes.description: Class for parceling and managing ring buffer shared memory regions in Android AAudio.

methods.name: setupMemory
methods.description: Configures shared memory regions for data, read, and write counters.

methods.name: getBytesPerFrame
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per audio frame.

methods.name: setBytesPerFrame
methods.description: Sets the number of bytes per audio frame.

methods.name: getFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Returns the number of frames per burst.

methods.name: setFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Sets the number of frames per burst.

methods.name: isFileDescriptorSafe
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptors are safe.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves shared memory parcels and descriptor.

methods.name: updateMemory
methods.description: Updates the memory regions based on another parcelable.

methods.name: getReadCounterSharedMemoryIndex
methods.description: Returns shared memory index for read counter.

methods.name: getWriteCounterSharedMemoryIndex
methods.description: Returns shared memory index for write counter.

methods.name: getDataSharedMemoryIndex
methods.description: Returns shared memory index for data.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the state of the parcelable for debugging.

methods.name: parcelable
methods.description: Returns a parcelable representation of the object.
